say:1:1620625001:0.text: Hey, Loran! Stop staring at your book already!
say:1:1620625001:0.source_cn: 喂，洛兰，别老盯着书看了！

say:2:1620625002:1.text: Hang on, I've been digging into this paper on teaching methods. Took forever to find, and I finally hit the part that makes it all click.
say:2:1620625002:1.source_cn: 等一下，我正琢磨一个教育问题，这篇文献找了好久，刚刚才...

say:3:1620625003:1.text: Oh come on, that can wait! <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s here, say hi!
say:3:1620625003:1.male: Oh come on, that can wait! <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s here, say hi!
say:3:1620625003:1.female: Oh come on, that can wait! <style="stress"><player_name></style>'s here, say hi!

say:6:1620625005:1.text: Me? Still goofing off as always.
say:6:1620625005:1.source_cn: 我挺好的，一如既往地混日子。
say:6:1620625005:1.male: Me? Still goofing off as always.
say:6:1620625005:1.female: Me? Still goofing off as always.

say:7:1620625006:0.text: As for Loran, well, he finally remembers to eat and sleep.
say:7:1620625006:0.source_cn: 至于洛兰，至少现在能按时吃饭睡觉了。
say:7:1620625006:0.male: As for Loran, well, he finally remembers to eat and sleep.
say:7:1620625006:0.female: As for Loran, well, he finally remembers to eat and sleep.

say:8:1620625007:0.text: I'm not pushing myself like before. If a student burns out, it ends up on the professor's plate too.
say:8:1620625007:0.source_cn: 影响健康的事我肯定不会再做了。毕竟学生要是出了状况，老...

say:9:1620625008:0.text: Ooh... this guy's totally changed. Used to be all about research. Now it's "education theory this," "good teaching that"—he won't shut up about it.
say:9:1620625008:0.source_cn: 呼……这小子现在变了，从之前的学术转移到教育学了，满嘴...

choice_prompt:10:1620625008.text: Ooh... this guy's totally changed. Used to be all about research. Now it's "education theory this," "good teaching that"—he won't shut up about it.
choice_prompt:10:1620625008.source_cn: 呼……这小子现在变了，从之前的学术转移到教育学了，满嘴都是这些，老师长老师短的……

say:11:1620625009:0.text: Right now? He's asking me to join him in studying... cardiac resuscitation massage. I kid you not!
say:11:1620625009:0.source_cn: 现在？这小子要我陪他去学习什么……心脏复苏按摩！

say:12:1620625011:0.text: No magic, just old-school emergency aid! I don't even get why he's so into it.
say:12:1620625011:0.source_cn: 完全不用魔法，都是原始的急救术，我真搞不懂学这个干嘛。

say:13:1620625012:1.text: Obviously, to protect my future students.
say:13:1620625012:1.source_cn: 当然是保护我未来的学生。

say:14:1620625013:1.text: What if something happens and I can't use magic? I want to be ready.
say:14:1620625013:1.source_cn: 想想看，要是遇到特殊情况，魔法用不了怎么办？

say:15:1620625014:1.text: Fair point. I should learn too... You never know when someone might faint from a ghost encounter again and need me to revive them.
say:15:1620625014:1.source_cn: 说的有道理，我也得学学，免得有人自己再被幽灵吓到，得我...

say:16:1620625015:1.text: Oh please, like you're one to talk.
say:16:1620625015:1.source_cn: 什么啊，你还好意思说别人吗？

say:17:1620625016:1.text: The two exchange a look and laugh.
say:17:1620625016:1.source_cn: 两人对视了一下，释怀地笑了。

say:18:1620625017:1.text: You know, thinking back to that echo in the middle of the night... it taught me more than any book ever could.
say:18:1620625017:1.source_cn: 说起来，那段深夜里的回声，现在想想……对我来说，更像是...
say:18:1620625017:1.male: You know, thinking back to that echo in the middle of the night... it taught me more than any book ever could.
say:18:1620625017:1.female: You know, thinking back to that echo in the middle of the night... it taught me more than any book ever could.

say:19:1620625018:1.text: After that, I started to reflect, not just on why I study, but on what scholarship even means.
say:19:1620625018:1.source_cn: 也是那之后，我开始思考研究学术的意义，甚至是……学术本...

choice_prompt:20:1620625018.text: After that, I started to reflect, not just on why I study, but on what scholarship even means.
choice_prompt:20:1620625018.source_cn: 也是那之后，我开始思考研究学术的意义，甚至是……学术本身存在的意义。

say:21:1620625019:1.text: Well, this is just my take, but I think the point of scholarship is to open new doors. To bring the unknown into focus, and light a path forward.
say:21:1620625019:1.source_cn: 当然，这只是我的拙见——我认为学术的存在，是为了点亮另...

say:22:1620625020:1.text: It's also a responsibility. We're building the future of Esperia together, one idea at a time.
say:22:1620625020:1.source_cn: 而学术，也是责任。背负着共创伊索米亚更好明天的责任。
say:22:1620625020:1.male: It's also a responsibility. We're building the future of Esperia together, one idea at a time.
say:22:1620625020:1.female: It's also a responsibility. We're building the future of Esperia together, one idea at a time.

say:23:1620625021:1.text: Maybe one day, I'll stand where Professor Movan once stood, passing on everything I've learned, along with this sense of purpose, to my students.
say:23:1620625021:1.source_cn: 或许将来，我也会站在莫温老师曾伫立的讲台上，将我毕生所...

say:24:1620625022:1.text: And his lessons... I'll never forget them. Teaching isn't just about knowledge—it's about seeing each student's joy, their confusion, and helping them keep going.
say:24:1620625022:1.source_cn: 至于莫温老师的教诲，我绝不会忘记。不只是传道授业，更要...

say:25:1620625023:1.text: Alright, "Professor Loran"—your emergency aid class is starting soon! You've still got a ways to go before you're teaching for real!
say:25:1620625023:1.source_cn: 好啦，洛兰“老师”——你的急救课真要迟到了！离你正式执...

say:27:1620625025:1.text: Time for class! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, thanks for everything... We'll see you around!
say:27:1620625025:1.male: Time for class! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, thanks for everything... We'll see you around!
say:27:1620625025:1.female: Time for class! <style="stress"><player_name></style>, thanks for everything... We'll see you around!

choice:20:0:1.text: And? What did you figure out?
choice:20:0:1.male: And? What did you figure out?
choice:20:0:1.female: And? What did you figure out?

choice:10:0:1.text: Where are you two headed now?
choice:10:0:1.male: Where are you two headed now?
choice:10:0:1.female: Where are you two headed now?

say:29:1620625010:1.text: Right? And now it's "let's learn cardiac resuscitation massage together!"
say:29:1620625010:1.source_cn: 可不是嘛……这会又要我陪他去学习什么……心脏复苏按摩！

choice:10:1:2.text: That's what it's like when a top student gets serious.
choice:10:1:2.source_cn: 学霸认真起来是这样的
choice:10:1:2.male: That's what it's like when a top student gets serious.
choice:10:1:2.female: That's what it's like when a top student gets serious.

choice:5:0:1.text: So, how have you two been?
choice:5:0:1.male: So, how have you two been?
choice:5:0:1.female: So, how have you two been?
